title: Workspace selection of an in-pass check (F153-FR-045 to F153-FR-047; data-model.md D15)
description: The record of one decision of the workspace-selection table (rules WS-1 to WS-7 of plan.md): which declared commands of the inner check set an in-pass check ran, or why the full set ran. PROPOSAL. Only declared fixed-argv commands are ever selected and none is synthesised (F153-FR-045); uncertainty selects the full set (F153-FR-046); the verification gate of the phase is never scoped (F153-FR-047, rule WS-2). No decision reads this record back (F153-FR-006).
